values.note: Online booking closes 7 days out; inside a week, book by phone with the office. Friday or Saturday arrivals must take two nights between Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends. note: Main developed campground on Lake Tschida (Heart Butte Reservoir), a Bureau of Reclamation lake run under a co-op with the Tri-Cities JJDA; the office and welcome center are on ND 49 by the dam. Five loops sit above the swim beach, fishing pier and boat ramp. Other camping areas around the lake include Downstream, Crappie Creek and Gilligan's Hilltop. --Claude
summary: laketschida.org read (maps, 7 loop pages, fees, campground and general info): 28 single electric sites (30/50 A) + two 8-site group loops + 18 primitive; $24 electric/$14 primitive; Peek booking 7+ days out, weekend 2-night summer minimum, 14-day limit, FCFS envelopes; dump. Lakefront -> lakeview. PIN ~1.3 km off (stored on the area west of Rimrock).
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE: lakefront -> lakeview (not an --AWH value). The stored evidence point 46.595,-101.829 is not Rimrock: it is ~1 km west, in the separate area west of the Rimrock loops. On the operator's loop maps and Esri imagery the Rimrock loops (centred ~46.5901,-101.8158) sit south of the shore: Loop A's north spurs (electric 12, 14, 16; primitive 1-5) are ~35-50 m from the water with the loop road and a continuous tree belt between (fishing pier at ~46.5910,-101.8164); primitive 30 and 31 are ~15-25 m from the shore under the same tree band; primitive 45-51 line the boat-ramp road behind trees with a marsh pond to the east; Loop B, the rest of Loop C and the D/E group loops are 100 m+ inland. The swim beach and day-use lot hold the open shore to the east. No nightly pad has an open apron to the water.

PIN: stored 46.59297,-101.83257 is ~1.3 km WNW of the campground, on a road junction with a building in the area west of Rimrock. Move to 46.5901,-101.8158 (the host/comfort-station field between Loops A, B and C).
PHONE: keep (701) 584-2201 (office / welcome center, matches Google).
WEBSITE: keep https://laketschida.org/rimrock and https://laketschida.org/; booking engine is Peek (booking.url).

BOOKING: fcfs left unset - unreserved sites go first come, first served by envelope (booking.note); the stored derived 'some_sites' is not what the page says. Loops D and E are online only as whole-loop group bookings.
SEASON: no season dates posted; 'Fall & winter activities include ... ice fishing' but nothing on campground opening - left unknown.

LEADS (not in campgrounds.json; nothing within 20 km but this entry): Lake Tschida's other camping areas on the same site - Crappie Creek (electric + primitive), Downstream (electric 1 and 2, primitive, cabins), Gilligan's Hilltop (electric), Hawabesi/Southside, Koehlers Point, Schatz's Point, Sled Creek (primitive) and Hidden Shelter Horse Camp; booking pages at https://laketschida.org/crappie-creek-electric, /downstream-electric-1, /gilligans-hilltop-elec. Unvetted.
GAME AND FISH: no ND Game and Fish camping rule applies; the lake is Reclamation land managed by the JJDA under its own 14-in-30 rule.
